metadata.description: Phi Tinh (Flying Stars) golden dataset — multi-source reference cases for FS-04/FS-05/FS-10 validation. Tiebreaker: Tham Thi Huyen Khong Hoc. Per ADR-0003a (2026-07-15, supersedes ADR-0003 §6), all canonical cases carry HIGH confidence after dual-source independent secondary modern verification (phongthuycaivan.org + lasotuvi.com / phongthuyso.vn); pre-1984 Thuong/Trung Nguyen polarity rows are HIGH per ADR-0003a.

cases.note: Thuong Nguyen cross-validation. HIGH confidence per ADR-0003a (2026-07-15): dual-source independent secondary modern verification via phongthuycaivan.org + lasotuvi.com, with Tham Thi Huyen Khong Hoc as classical tiebreaker. ADR-0003a supersedes ADR-0003 §6 MEDIUM caveat. No divergence recorded.

cases.tiebreaker: Tham Thi Huyen Khong Hoc: Canh Ty 1960 Trung Nguyen Van 6, center Ngu Hoang (5) per Tham Thi Huyen Khong Hoc polarity matrix; lasotuvi.com (6) rejected as Van-number confusion. HIGH confidence per ADR-0003a (2026-07-15) — HIGH polarity-row confidence does NOT resolve the case-level 5-vs-6 center-value split; case-level disposition is PendingExternalReview per Plan 16-02.
cases.note: Trung Nguyen cross-validation. Polarity-row HIGH per ADR-0003a (dual-source independent secondary modern verification via phongthuycaivan.org + lasotuvi.com/phongthuyso.vn, with Tham Thi Huyen Khong Hoc as classical tiebreaker). Case-level center-value split (5 vs 6) is PendingExternalReview — our_value=5 retained per Tham Thi tiebreaker, divergence logged in known_divergences per FS-10, NOT silently corrected.

known_divergences.tiebreaker: Tham Thi Huyen Khong Hoc polarity matrix selects center=5 (Ngu Hoang) for Canh Ty 1960 Trung Nguyen; lasotuvi.com value 6 appears to conflate center star with Van number. Center 5 remains the provisional *Tham Thi Huyen Khong Hoc* operational value pending external review (deferral: 2026-12-31, external-huyen-khong-reviewer). Polarity-row confidence HIGH per ADR-0003a (2026-07-15, dual-source independent secondary modern verification).
known_divergences.note: PendingExternalReview disposition per ADR-0003a §4 — case-level center-value split (5 vs 6) is NOT resolved by the HIGH polarity-row confidence upgrade. our_value=5 retained as the provisional *Tham Thi Huyen Khong Hoc* operational value while review is pending; divergence logged per FS-10, NOT silently corrected. See structured deferral marker below.

deferral.reason: phongthuycaivan.org=5 and lasotuvi.com=6 remain unresolved; independent secondary verification does not settle the center-star encoding
